pages.text: NetheryX overhauls the Nether: $(l)12 new biomes$(), $(l)19 creatures$() including three bosses, $(l)3 great dungeons$() and small camps, the $(item)Onyx$() material, new crops, foods, tools and many useful items.$(br2)The vanilla biomes change too: new plants and creatures appear everywhere.
pages.title: NetheryX

pages.text: This codex is given once to every player. Lost it? Craft a new one with a $(item)Book$() and a $(item)Netherrack$() block.$(br2)It follows your game language (English or French).
pages.title: Le Codex
